heading: Recognition and enforcement of foreign arbitral decisions and awards; reciprocity
lead: Arbitral decisions or awards made in the territory of a foreign State shall, on the basis of reciprocity, be recognized and enforced under this chapter only if that State has ratified or acceded to the Inter-American Convention.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective upon the entry into force of the Inter-American Convention on International Commercial Arbitration of January 30, 1975, with respect to the United States (Oct. 27, 1990), see section 3 of Pub. L. 101–369, set out as a note under section 301 of this title.

ancestors.heading: INTER-AMERICAN CONVENTION ON INTERNATIONAL COMMERCIAL ARBITRATION
